analysis: The code snippet calls Thread.sleep(millis) inside a try-catch block. The API documentation declares two exceptions: IllegalArgumentException (if millis is negative) and InterruptedException (if the thread is interrupted). The preceding condition checks if millis > 0, which ensures millis is not negative, thus IllegalArgumentException is avoided. InterruptedException can occur at any time during sleep due to thread interruption; there is no pre-check to prevent it, and the catch block handles it after it is thrown, meaning the exception is not avoided.
answer: IllegalArgumentException: avoided by the condition millis > 0. InterruptedException: not avoided because interruption is asynchronous and cannot be prevented by pre-checks.
remark: InterruptedException is triggered when any thread interrupts the current thread while it is sleeping. Since interruption can happen asynchronously at any time, no validation or check before the sleep call can prevent this exception from being thrown.
